luiskr.com / core/utils/media / webpSibling

function webpSibling(url): string

Defined in: core/utils/media.ts:131

Derives the .webp sibling of a .jpg URL — the compressed-variant naming convention replaces only the extension, so the webp sits beside the original at the same path ("if webp exists" is decided by the request, no manifest lookup). Returns '' for non-.jpg input so callers can conditionally render a .

Parameters

url

string

JPG media URL.

Returns

string

The same URL with .webp instead of .jpg, or '' when not .jpg.
